name: deliver-web-change
summary: Deliver a bounded user-visible repository change through Designer specification, Developer implementation, rendered Designer review, and fresh-context Verifier review, with evidence bound to the final artifact state before closure.
inputs: work order with target repository, bounded change, and acceptance criteria
approved content and/or approved design direction when the change is user-visible
client Brand, Voice, Design Tokens, and Stack notes when the change is client-scoped
target environment and rich artifact identity record (artifact ID, kind, source ref, identity method/value, state, and timestamp)
writes: target repository files through the developer stage
design specification and acceptance matrix through the designer stage
verification and review reports when requested by the work contract
external_reads: rendered local or staging URLs, screenshots, console and network evidence for review stages
repository remotes or CI status when explicitly scoped
approval_gates: production or deployment is a separate approval-gated operation outside this workflow
done_when: acceptance criteria are explicit and bound to the work order
implementation evidence names repository, branch, changed files, tests, build, and runnable artifact identity
designer rendered review and verifier review are separate judgments bound to the final artifact state
every acceptance criterion has an observed PASS/FIX/BLOCK/UNDECIDED result with evidence
any post-review implementation change invalidated prior review and triggered re-dispatch against the final state
artifact identity ledger records final and superseded states with review bindings
parent gate closed only on review evidence, never on producer self-report
verification: node .agents/scripts/verify-workflows.mjs
focused test suite: node --test .agents/scripts/verify-workflows.test.mjs
repository gate: node .agents/scripts/gate.mjs
target repository, environment, approved content/design, acceptance criteria, approval class, and rich artifact identity record are explicit

stages.condition: visual intent or an approved design is absent or insufficient for the bounded change
verification: acceptance matrix maps each visual/behavioral criterion to an observable check
specification separates authority, current-system facts, observations, proposals, and gaps

stages.condition: approved design or acceptance matrix exists; platform skill selected from inspected repository manifests, never from task wording alone
verification: project-native tests, build, and lint run with exact results
diff inspected for scope, secrets, generated files, and unrelated churn
repository, branch, changed files, runnable artifact identity, and artifact ledger record reported
rendered output compared only against the approved design and observable quality contract
representative desktop, mobile, intermediate widths, and relevant interaction states inspected when evidence is available
conformance issues reported with evidence, owner, severity, and recheck scope
acceptance criteria translated into observable checks across browser, responsive, interaction, computed/rendered result, console/network, accessibility, and metadata surfaces
HTTP 200 or build success never accepted as satisfaction of visual or behavioral criteria
risk-based collateral surfaces checked; every criterion returns PASS/FIX/BLOCK/UNDECIDED with measured evidence

stages.condition: meaningful code risk or independent engineering review requested by the work contract
verification: fixed comparison boundary established; diff reviewed against explicit acceptance criteria and non-goals
regression risk traced through callers, state boundaries, and error paths
every material finding carries direct evidence, severity, location, and disposition
review evidence bound to the final artifact identity ID and its hash, commit, build, or URL state
PASS closes; FIX routes to implementation; BLOCK or UNDECIDED reports the missing proof or approval
producer self-report never closes the workflow
